title: UPDATE: TwitchCon San Diego Meetup Details
message: Hey, Firebot fans. We weren't able to get a separate venue, so we're taking over the official Chat Moderators & Software Dev Community MeetUp at TwitchCon! For more details (and to see the exclusive Firebot sticker zunder will be giving out), check out either the Discord announcement or zunder's post on Bluesky. See you in San Diego!

title: Feature YOUR stream on the Firebot website!
message: Hey there, Firebot users! Did you know YOUR stream could be featured on the Firebot website? Just go to Settings, then General, and enable the Feature My Stream setting. That's it! After that, whenever you're live on Twitch while running Firebot, your stream will automatically appear on our website.
